svg.title: SMC clocking
svg.text: module smc · names in monospace for PD stamping
one arrow per clock per subsystem, tip at its wall
box tint shows the clock of each instance inside
swatch fill = instance box tint for that domain · multi-domain instances banded top→bottom in arrow order
internal logic of the parent module
rows: left half = source clock · right half = destination clock
reset syncs only — no clock mods
